notes: Add to AnyItem now has everything an item has (count, expiry, price, tags, notes, warranty, documents), with where it goes at the bottom.
Modules and categories stand out more from the background, in every look.
The restock list on a sheet matches the modules' colour.
Money: pick the time frame from one menu, now with Last 7 days and Custom dates. The chart sits in the middle of the page.
Dropdowns, dates, suggestions and "are you sure" questions all use AnyItem's own windows.
If Google asks you to sign in or prove you're not a robot, picture and product searches switch to Bing.
Need a photo? in Buy from searches pictures right in the app.
Manuals and documents takes one line until you press + Add manual/document.
In Edit, tapping or dragging a module's name picks or moves it instead of renaming it.
Modules no longer have the In group menu at the bottom.
Notes open big only from the expand button.
The barcode scanner shows the camera the right way round, and switching between Barcode and Photo keeps the camera on.
After scanning, closing Find where to buy it takes you back to your choices.
The sheets page keeps its own zoom, and opening the sidebar no longer squeezes a module's toolbar.
